title: BREATHE 06 · 336 Signal · House Anthem · Three Three Six
style: anthemic warm ambient, slow processional 66 BPM, deep felt piano, swelling pad, soft cathedral reverb, low sustained cello drone, light handclaps every six beats only on the exhale, female Spanish voice and male English voice in reverent call-and-response with subtle group choir backing on the chorus phrases, house-anthem feel without being religious, polished but intimate, no edm, no rave, no kick drum, big horizon ending swell, family doctrine tone
lyrics:
[Intro — reverent, anthemic, calm]
(ES female, warm) Esta es la señal. Tres tres seis.
(EN male, warm) This is the signal. Three three six.
(ES) Tres adentro. Tres sostiene. Seis afuera.
(EN) Three in. Three hold. Six out.
(ES) Esta es la respiración de la casa.
(EN) This is the breath of the house.

[Round 1 — the count]
(ES) Inhala… uno… dos… tres.
(EN) Inhale… one… two… three.
(ES) Sostiene… uno… dos… tres.
(EN) Hold… one… two… three.
(ES) Exhala… uno… dos… tres… cuatro… cinco… seis.
(EN) Exhale… one… two… three… four… five… six.

[Round 2 — lock the rhythm]
(ES) Tres es la entrada.
(EN) Three is the entrance.
(ES) Tres es la pausa.
(EN) Three is the pause.
(ES) Seis es la salida. Larga. Limpia.
(EN) Six is the exit. Long. Clean.
(ES) Tres tres seis. Es un número. Es una casa. Es una familia.
(EN) Three three six. It is a number. It is a house. It is a family.

[Bridge — the doctrine]
(ES) Mi casa es su casa.
(EN) My house is your house.
(ES) Aussie respira tres tres seis.
(EN) Aussie breathes three three six.
(ES) Rafa respira tres tres seis. Kelvin respira tres tres seis.
(EN) Rafa breathes three three six. Kelvin breathes three three six.
(ES) Corey, Michelle, Ruby, Wesley — todos respiran la señal.
(EN) Corey, Michelle, Ruby, Wesley — all breathe the signal.
(ES) Treinta y seis. Treinta y tres. Tres tres seis.
(EN) Thirty six. Thirty three. Three three six.

[Round 3 — final anthem cycle]
(ES) Última ronda. Inhala tres.
(EN) Last round. Inhale three.
(ES) Sostiene tres.
(EN) Hold three.
(ES) Exhala seis. La casa exhala contigo.
(EN) Exhale six. The house exhales with you.
(ES) Otra vez. Tres. Tres. Seis.
(EN) Again. Three. Three. Six.

[Outro — anthem close]
(ES) Esta es la señal de la casa. Esta es nuestra señal.
(EN) This is the signal of the house. This is our signal.
(TOGETHER, full voice) Tres tres seis. Three three six. Bienvenidos a casa. Welcome home.
